# NewRssFeed — Project Context

## Verified project details

- Repository: https://github.com/korayozkan/NewRssFeedbeta
- Website: https://korayozkan.github.io/NewRssFeedbeta/
- License: MIT (see LICENSE.md in the repository)
- Contact: kiruhiofficial@proton.me
- The repository contains a TypeScript/Vite website with Turkish and English landing-page content.
- The current website is a landing page and interface concept. It is not the functioning feed product.

## Product direction

The project aims to explore bringing content from YouTube, Reddit, GitHub, X, and Medium into one feed, with shared discovery with friends. These are goals described by the project; support, availability, and release timing have not been confirmed.

## Availability and contact

- Beta access is not open; no opening date has been announced.
- Pricing and product data-handling details have not been announced.
- The landing-page form opens a `mailto:` draft. The visitor must send it manually. The website does not save or submit an application to a server.
- Email: kiruhiofficial@proton.me
- Discord: https://discord.gg/wBw3NwqhsR
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/newrssfeed/

## Development

The repository uses Vite, TypeScript, and Express for local/production serving. See README.md for setup instructions and package scripts.
